goal: Close audit P0-3: replace state synthesis with typed domain tools over a mock order/booking service — append-only effect log, idempotency keys, policy enforcement at the service boundary, simulated success/definite-failure/unknown outcomes, and an evaluator-side state projection for the grader.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The mock service owns the state and the append-only effect log; effects carry idempotency keys and receipts; the written policy is enforced at the service boundary.
Per-effect fault injection supports success, definite failure, and timeout-unknown; unknown outcomes never mutate state and are queryable by idempotency key.

Seven typed tools register on ctx.tools (get_order, get_booking, issue_refund, create_return_label, change_booking, refuse_request, get_effect_status) with dsh-tools schemas; the plugin builds as part of the repo build chain.
The full gate passes on the branch.

outcome.summary: Typed workflow tools and the mock service shipped: the agent's effect path is now tool-mediated with receipts, fault simulation, and policy enforcement in the service — the grader reads service state via an evaluator-side projection.

what_worked: Keeping the service core free of dsh imports made it directly unit-testable; the tool layer is a thin typed wrapper.
dsh-tools' schema vocabulary (json type, no union arrays) was resolved with an explicit found flag plus json payloads.

calls.name: implement-service
calls.purpose: Build the mock service core, the tool registrations, plugin build wiring, and the state projection.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run the full repository verification gate.

evidence.summary: Five service tests: refund success plus idempotent replay, policy-boundary denials, unknown-outcome simulation with status query, labels/booking/refusal flows, and the evaluator-side projection.
The plugin compiles into lib/ as part of the repo build chain (typecheck and build both cover it).
Typecheck, build, 148 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed on improvements/audit-borrows.

uncertainty.statement: The tools have not been mounted into a real dsh profile yet; execution through an actual headless session is the G0 demo step.
uncertainty.resolution: The image bake plus the patch overlay enabling the tools row are the next increment, followed by the G0/G1 paired demo.

notes: Deterministic implementation and unit tests only; no model calls, external transfers, or profile mounts this round.
